verdict.rationale: Framer's AI agent explicitly generates editable pages, sections, copy, and visuals directly in a project from natural-language prompts (e.g., color/typography changes, layout reorganization, dark mode conversion, homepage restructuring), matching the story's core ask of first drafts/layouts/mockups produced by the tool. Missing for 10: independent hands-on reviews/benchmarks validating output quality and reliability of the AI design generation feature, and detail on limitations or failure modes of the AI agent itself.
